. Trabalhar na Tenda é viver desafios reais, com impacto direto na vida de milhares de famílias e também na sua própria trajetória.

Acreditamos que a
diversidade e a inclusão
tornam nosso time mais forte. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a profissionais com deficiência (PcD), reforçando nosso compromisso com um ambiente plural, respeitoso e colaborativo.

Agora queremos te contar mais sobre a vaga de
Coordenador de Segurança da Informação
na área de
TI
e como você pode construir o futuro junto com a gente.

VemPraTenda


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coordenar o time e as iniciativas de Segurança da Informação, assegurando alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas, auditorias e políticas de compliance (LGPD, ISO 27001, NIST, entre outras);
  • Implementar, monitorar e aprimorar controles de segurança baseados em soluções como ZTNA, DLP, MFA, XDR e antivírus corporativo, garantindo defesa em camadas e resposta rápida a incidentes;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida de acessos (provisão, revisão e desprovisão) em sistemas corporativos, promovendo automação e aderência aos princípios de least privilege e segregação de funções;
  • Conduzir investigações de incidentes de segurança, elaborando relatórios executivos e planos de mitigação.
  • Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs e KRIs) de segurança e acessos, com foco em riscos, conformidade e performance dos controles;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, assegurando evidências, planos de ação e melhoria contínua dos controles;
  • Promover treinamentos e campanhas de conscientização sobre Segurança da Informação e Privacidade, fortalecendo a cultura de segurança entre colaboradores e parceiros;
  • Atuar em conjunto com os times de Infraestrutura, Redes, Jurídico e Compliance, garantindo conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) e demais normativos;
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco em novos sistemas, fornecedores e prestadores de serviço (MSPs);
  • Gerenciar contratos e SLAs de MSPs existentes;
  • Coordenar e supervisionar processos de desenvolvimento seguro, incluindo análises SAST, DAST e IAST em aplicações críticas;
  • Coordenar testes de invasão (pentests) e atividades de threat modelling, assegurando a identificação e mitigação de riscos nas aplicações.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em Gestão de Acessos, Controles de Segurança, LGPD e Governança de TI;
  • Conhecimento prático em soluções de segurança, como:
  • ZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access) – controle de acesso baseado em identidade e contexto;
  • DLP (Data Loss Prevention) – prevenção de vazamento de dados;
  • MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) – autenticação forte e segura;
  • XDR (Extended Detection and Response) – detecção e resposta avançada a ameaças;
  • Experiência com frameworks de segurança, como NIST, CIS, ISO 27001 e COBIT;
  • Vivência em processos de auditoria, gestão de riscos e resposta a incidentes;
  • Certificações desejáveis: CISM, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer ou LGPD Foundation;
  • Conhecimento em Segurança em Cloud, preferencialmente AWS e GCP;
  • Conhecimento em Kubernetes será considerado um diferencial;
  • Experiência com PAM (Privileged Access Management) – gestão de acessos privilegiados e cofres de senhas.

title: Product Manager
description:
Location: Campinas - SP
Employment Type: Full-Time - 100% On Site

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world's top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we're number one or two in many of the world's top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You'll Do

As a Product Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You'll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.
  • Building and managing product roadmaps, aligning them with strategic goals while balancing stakeholder priorities.
  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user-centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.
  • Using data and metrics to drive decision-making, develop business cases, and measure success.
  • Writing detailed business requirements and user stories for clear communication with the development team.
  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.
  • Monitoring and communicating product performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing solutions.
  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You'll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium-to-large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem-solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user-centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus* 
  • Private pension plan
  • Meal Allowance
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Medicines discounts
  • WellHub partnership
  • Childcare subsidies
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • Clube Ben partnership
  • Scholarship*
  • School materials assurance*
  • Transport allowance

*Rules applied

title: Finance Project Analyst
description:
Netcracker Shaping the Digital Future


As a proud subsidiary of NEC Corporation, Netcracker is a global software leader driving innovation at scale. We combine an open Agentic AI Platform with Cloud Native IT Solutions to help telecommunication providers transform, innovate, and deliver results that matter. Powered by cutting-edge technology—and the passion of our people—we unlock new opportunities, spark innovation, and create better digital experiences for millions worldwide. Join us and be part of a team that is not just keeping up with the digital future—we're leading it.

About the role


The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. Responsibilities include preparing and analyzing financial reports, collaborating with Project Managers on resourcing and discrepancies, and supporting project closeouts. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs 
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • Record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes

Required Experience

  • 4 or more years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others 
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode 

Education 

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: Junior Account Executive
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

About the Role


As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for supporting and developing relationships with customers across Latin America, helping them bring their products to market faster through Toradex solutions.
You will act as the bridge between customers and our technical experts — understanding their needs, proposing high-value solutions, and ensuring the success of each project.
This position is ideal for ambitious, results-driven professionals who want to grow in a global environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Expand the customer base and increase revenue in the region by identifying new opportunities and building strategic relationships.
  • Act in a consultative manner, supporting and winning design-in projects by understanding technical needs and positioning Toradex solutions as the best choice.
  • Ensure customer success during development by overseeing technical evaluations and coordinating issue resolution with internal experts.
  • Strengthen relationships with existing customers by anticipating needs, tracking project progress, and exploring upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Ideal Profile

  • Passion for technology and helping customers turn ideas into real products.
  • Hands-on mindset with a strong focus on problem-solving.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly translate technical concepts.
  • Proactive in identifying risks and anticipating solutions.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, initiative, and focus on high-impact results.
  • Collaborative profile, able to work in teams on complex opportunities.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written); Spanish is a plus.

Desired Technical Knowledge

  • Genuine interest in technology and curiosity to learn about technical products.
  • Good understanding of general technology concepts (processors, devices, software updates, connectivity).
  • Ability to engage with engineers and understand customers' technical needs.
  • Willingness to continuously learn about technical areas related to Toradex products.
  • General knowledge of operating systems and software development.

What We Offer

  • A global, agile, and collaborative corporate culture.
  • Access to cutting-edge technologies and direct contact with highly skilled engineers.
  • Freedom to propose ideas, shape processes, and make a real impact.
  • Flexible work model and a modern, innovative environment.
  • Concrete opportunities for personal and professional growth.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Flexible working hours
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Job Description

Programa de Estágio 2026

Power Conversion & Storage Campinas

Quem somos:

 O negócio de Power Conversion & Storage da GE Vernova combina sistemas avançados de conversão e armazenamento de energia para atender às necessidades de eletrificação de concessionárias e indústrias. Com foco na estabilidade energética, no armazenamento de energia e em soluções para a eletrificação industrial, Power Conversion & Storage capacita os clientes ao abordar seus desafios mais complexos de eletrificação e acelerar sua transição para um futuro sustentável e descarbonizado.

Objetivo desta posição:

Estágio na área de Gerenciamento de Custos de Produto (Product Cost Management) no setor de engenharia de produto de máquinas elétricas (motores e geradores), atuando na análise profunda dos custos que componham o projeto assim como toda a sua execução desde a venda, passando pela engenharia e execução fabril. 

O estagiário(a) apoiará a equipe nas análises entendendo as oportunidades de redução de custo do produto e evitando erosões de margem impactando de forma direta a GE Vernova no crescimento de vendas e aumento de margem operacional.

Principais atividades:

  • Analisar projetos em execução comparando o custo vendido com o projetado e executado, entendendo as divergências e oportunidades e assim gerando relatórios com ações preventivas e corretivas fazendo interface entre os times de vendas, compras, engenharia e manufatura;

  • Automação e criação de ferramentas de análise de dados estratégicos com o objetivo de redução de custo de produto e aumento da competitividade, análise de eficiência e KPIs de custo;

  • Manutenção do modelo de custeio de produto refletindo as regras de projeto e manufatura para o time de vendas;

  • Desenvolver apresentações e relatórios para suporte a área de engenharia de custos;

  • Atuar em projetos de melhoria contínua, automação de processos e digitalização de ferramentas;

  • Aprendizado sobre o produto de máquinas elétricas rotativas e sua cadeia de produção.

Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando Engenharia Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção, Controle e Automação com previsão de formatura a partir de Dezembro/27;

  • Inglês intermediário;

  • Pacote Office intermediário (principalmente Excel e PowerPoint);

  • Interesse em temas como competitividade de mercado, redução de custos, Lean Manufacturing e finanças;

  • Ter disponibilidade de estagiar em Campinas/SP, regime híbrido, com início em Janeiro/2026.

Perfil:

  • Boa capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico;

  • Organização e atenção a detalhes;

  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal e comunicação.

Nossos benefícios:

  • Bolsa estágio compatível com o mercado;

  • Seguro de Vida;

Para apoiar o seu desenvolvimento:

  • Acompanhamento na experiência: rodas de conversa com RH para suporte, e gestão da performance baseada em feedbacks recorrentes e avaliações a cada 6 meses.

description:
Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high-code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning.

We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G as one of the world's top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast.

We're a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you're looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we'd love for you to join us on this journey.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands-on problem-solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and good communicator.

Responsibilities

  • Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools).
  • Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, warranties.
  • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly.
  • Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing).
  • Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching).
  • Support onboarding and off-boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g. deeper system issues).

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g. Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).
  • Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk, ServiceNow).
  • Hands-on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks.
  • Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.
  • Experience with inventory / asset management systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work autonomously.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese - Fluent.
  • English - Advanced.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.
  • Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection).
  • Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth, and fast-paced startup environment or technology companies.

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Overview


As a Product Security Engineer at Toradex, you'll be responsible for the implementation, validation, and maintenance of security features in Toradex's embedded software stack. That means hands-on, low-level work with bootloaders, Linux kernel security features, secure software updates and more.

We aim to make embedded software development easy and approachable, which means that our engineers have to go beyond just feature enablement. Your work will involve making the developer experience of working with low-level security features as smooth as it possibly can be. You'll work on systems used in critical industries like healthcare, industrial automation, and robotics.

Responsibilities

  • Security feature enablement: Bring up security features on new hardware. Every new product we release, we strive to have a uniform, straightforward experience for enabling basic hardware security features like secure boot, ARM TrustZone/OP-TEE, and hardware-backed encryption.
  • System-level hardening: Toradex maintains Torizon OS, a secure, production-ready embedded Linux OS. Making sure that security features fit into the whole stack, and that configurations are secure-by-default for the most common and supported workflows is a key part of the job. Understanding how everything fits together is a must.
  • Vulnerability management: Monitor upstream CVEs, assess their impact on Toradex products and their likely impact on Toradex customers' products. Apply patches and mitigations. Help draft security advisories and write VEX documents. Work on and maintain internal tooling for vulnerability management.
  • Security testing and automation: Automate test coverage of security features. Familiarity with LAVA or other hardware-in-the-loop embedded testing methodologies and frameworks is a strong plus.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in embedded systems security or adjacent areas (e.g. Linux security engineering)
  • Hands-on experience with bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), kernel security features, and embedded Linux distributions/build systems (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, buildroot, etc.)
  • Solid C/C++ coding and debugging skills
  • Experience with automating security checks in CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of threat modeling/risk modeling methodologies and how they relate to regulatory and standards compliance is a plus
  • Knowledge of security evaluation and analysis tools like fuzzers and static analysis tools is a plus

What we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Flexible working hours
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Quality Assurance Engineer (QA) with TypeScript and

Position Overview:

As a Quality Assurance Engineer at The Methodical Group, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and usability of our applications built on TypeScript and foundations. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and designers, to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet our clients' needs and exceed their expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

Test Planning and Strategy: Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies based on project requirements and specifications. Identify testing objectives, scope, and priorities to ensure thorough test coverage.

Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests to verify the functionality, performance, and security of web applications built on TypeScript and Conduct regression testing, smoke testing, and exploratory testing as needed.

Defect Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects using issue tracking systems. Collaborate with development teams to investigate and resolve issues in a timely manner.

Automation Testing: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using testing frameworks and libraries specific to TypeScript and Continuously enhance test automation frameworks to improve efficiency and reliability.

Quality Assurance Processes: Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance QA processes, tools, and methodologies. Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for software quality assurance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, provide feedback on design and functionality, and ensure alignment with quality standards.

Documentation: Create and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test cases, test reports, and other relevant artifacts. Ensure that documentation is accurate, up-to-date, and accessible to team members.

Qualifications:

Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.

Proven experience in quality assurance/testing of web applications, preferably using TypeScript and technologies.

Solid understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices.

Proficiency in test automation using testing frameworks/tools.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Experience with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) is a plus.

Knowledge of continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools is desirable.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões?

Aqui lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Se você é uma pessoa organizada, tem senso de espaço e um bom olhar para entender

Ter agilidade e dinamismo para atuar nos diferentes setores da loja.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Para jogar bonito, você precisa ter:

SOBRE A CENTAURO

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado, afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões

  • Automatizar processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados;

  • Desenvolver automatizações robóticas de processos (RPA) visando melhorias de processos;

  • Interagir com áreas técnicas (TD, infraestrutura, segurança) para garantir conformidade e funcionamento do ambiente;

  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender necessidades de dados e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas;

  • Relacionar-se com diversas áreas com boa comunicação, traduzindo temas técnicos em linguagem clara, adaptada ao público, mobilizando e acompanhando ações;

  • Documentar os processos e fluxos de dados construídos;

  • Analisar tendências e cenários e sugerir planos de ação

  • Automatizar processos de monitoramento de métricas

title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.

QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

title: Sales manager
description:
The Company


The world's leading supplier of mineral-based specialty solutions for industry with 14,000 employees, operations in more than 40 countries, and €4.3 billion in revenue in 2022. Imerys delivers high-value-added, functional solutions to a great number of sectors, from processing industries to consumer goods. The Group draws on its understanding of applications, technological knowledge and expertise in material science to deliver solutions by beneficiating its mineral resources, synthetic minerals and formulations. Imerys' solutions contribute essential properties to customers' products and their performance, including heat resistance, hardness, conductivity, opacity, durability, purity, lightness, filtration, absorption and water repellency. Imerys is determined to develop responsibly, in particular by fostering the emergence of environmentally-friendly products and processes. If you want to grow your skills and develop your career, find out more at 

The Position

Sales manager

Job Summary

Company

On March 28, 2024, Imerys Group ) published a press release announcing it has entered into exclusive negotiations with Flacks Group  for the contemplated divestment of its assets producing kaolin, ground calcium carbonate ("GCC"), precipitated calcium carbonate ("PCC"), and talc, which primarily serve the paper markets in North Americas, South America, Asia and Europe.

The future company formed by all these industrial sites, kaolin mine, port and logistic hubs is foreseen to start its operation under a new brand in the course of 2024. It will offer mineral solutions for industries worldwide. Currently serving mostly the paper and board markets , the new company will use its global footprint, unique assets and longstanding know-how to develop new business opportunities and foster innovation. Sustainability is a core value of this company.

With an annual revenue of around 350 million euros in 2023, this activity will employ about 1000 employees. The Company needs to reinforce the existing teams to operate as a standalone organization but also to meet its ambitious development plans.

Role overview

Drive organic and inorganic growth for customers and prospects in the perimeter you are responsible for. Support business and market developments, working with Business Development, S&T and Marketing. 

Be responsible for the profitability of the activity on all the customers present in your perimeter.  

Missions

- Develop and Execute the commercial roadmaps developed for your segment / products / perimeter;

- Execution of price increase as per the pricing strategy;

- Account Management, scope includes (but not limited to): negotiating short term and long term contracts, identifying growth / profitability improvement opportunities and advancing relationships with customers in order to maximize our share in the addressable markets

- Ensure business performance by servicing existing customer base (or exceeding) their expectations and developing new growth opportunities

- Develop plans and strategies for developing new commercial opportunities and achieving the sales goals with a strong ability to build both internal and external relationships;

- Establishing and nurturing relationships with customers (multi-level management - upper management, purchasing, R&D);

- Analyses of sales trends and preparation of reports for management and advise on business;

- Participate to the building of the annual sales plan, budget, forecasts and mid term plan for your perimeter;

- Ensure forecast accuracy and jointly manage customer relationship with Customer Service Team;

- Ensure the promotion of customer focus in the organization. 

- Feed CRM with customer, market and competitor information

Responsibilities

The commitment of the employee goes beyond respecting rules and procedures. Each employee is responsible to identify and report unsafe situations, in order to guarantee that corrective actions are implemented before an accident happens. The employees should develop ideas to improve safety and have an active role in its implementation. 

The employee is responsible for her/his own safety and other members of the team. Safety is everybody 's commitment. She/he should use the correct PPE; know and follow the norms / protocols / procedures of EHS. Ist is important that the employee is committed to sustainable actions, focusing on activities to lower our impact in the environment, acting with ethics, and respecting diversity and inclusion. 

Knowledge and skills: 

- Strong leadership skills to find win-win solutions both internally and externally

- Strong time management skills necessary to balance rigorous field work schedule

- Strong technical skills to understand how our products add value to the customer

- Strong knowledge of the Paper & Board Market

 

Typical profile:

- Business acumen and technical appetite

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills

- Energetic top performer who is ready to meet the requirements of a demanding customer base

 

Qualification & Experience:

Degree in preferably Chemistry, or Chemical or Mechanical Engineering

Experience: minimum 5 years experience on commercial role with strong exposure to complex customers 

Fluent in English and Spanish

Gerenciar o planejamento estratégico da região, acompanhamento de resultados, relacionamento com cliente e análise de mercado.

Garantir a excelência nos serviços oferecidos pela empresa, alinhando as demandas dos clientes com as soluções de facilites e manutenção.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

Prospecção e Desenvolvimento de Negócios:

Identificar e prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades de negócios na região.

Desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas às necessidades dos clientes, considerando os serviços de facilities (limpeza, segurança, recepção, conservação, etc.).

Construir e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com os principais clientes da região.

Análise de Mercado e Competição:

Monitorar o mercado local de facilities, identificando tendências, necessidades e oportunidades de crescimento.

Analisar a concorrência e buscar soluções diferenciadas para garantir a competitividade da empresa.

Coletar feedback dos clientes e da equipe para ajustar estratégias comerciais e melhorar os serviços oferecidos.

Realizar a análise de swot identificando fortalezas e fraquezas, ameaças e oportunidades traduzindo num plano de trabalho eficaz com geração de valor.

Gestão de Metas e Resultados:

Estabelecer e monitorar metas de vendas e performance comercial da região.

Controlar indicadores de performance (KPIs) como volume de vendas, rentabilidade e satisfação do cliente.

Garantir a entrega dos resultados financeiros e operacionais esperados para a região.

Relacionamento com Clientes:

Acompanhar e garantir a satisfação dos clientes com os serviços prestados pela empresa.

Atuar como ponto de contato principal para grandes contas e contratos corporativos.

Resolver problemas e negociar termos e condições com clientes, quando necessário.

Gestão de Orçamentos e Propostas Comerciais:

Elaborar orçamentos e propostas comerciais detalhadas, alinhando os serviços e soluções às necessidades dos clientes.

Trabalhar com a área financeira para garantir que os contratos sejam lucrativos e atendam às expectativas de rentabilidade.

Colaboração Interdepartamental:

Trabalhar de forma integrada com os stakeholders para garantir a execução eficaz dos serviços contratados.

Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com a lideranças para reportar resultados e definir estratégias.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO

Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Publicidade ou áreas afins.

Experiência: Sólida experiência em vendas e gestão comercial, preferencialmente em empresas de facilities, serviços terceirizados ou segmentos similares.

Habilidades:

Capacidade de liderança e motivação.

Habilidade de negociação e comunicação com clientes e parceiros.

Pro atividade na busca por novas oportunidades de negócios.

Visão estratégica para análise de mercado e desenvolvimento de planos comerciais.

Conhecimento em gestão de contratos e propostas comerciais.

Accountability.

Experiência em gestão de equipes distribuídas geograficamente.

Habilidade em gestão de resultados e controle de metas.
